study: Action-response JEPA and identifiable local RF calibration
scope: One real Sionna RT warehouse fixture; context-held-out response identification, not unseen warehouses, measured robot traffic, SOTA or a guaranteed JEPA advantage
pose_definition: For each y in linspace(-5,2,12), x=-0.7,+0.7; blocker z=1.5 m
kernel_quantity: G[receiver,transmitter] is incoherent sum of squared complex RT path coefficients; unit activity means 1 mW configured transmitted power. Distinct signals are assumed incoherent for average power addition.
coverage_gate: Require all 24x2x2 coupling_valid flags true and finite positive coupling; stop on incomplete coverage. Never replace missing paths by invented kernels.
constructed_episode: H=diag(receiver gain)*G with independent unknown receiver gain uniform[-3,3]dB each episode. Measured RF power is H*a + known receiver floor + additive zero-mean Gaussian measurement noise. These are explicit simulated device assumptions, not hardware measurements.
normalisation: Per-receiver scale is training-context mean sum(G,transmitter); no validation/test coupling enters normalisation or numerical priors. Known floor=0.1*scale mW; measurement sigma=0.01*scale mW. Reject nonpositive/nonfinite measurements rather than clip or invent values.
query: Known current activity [0.5,0.5], planned delta activity sampled uniformly[-0.5,0.5]^2; target future measured signed power difference, with independent noise on before/after powers. Clean H*delta is evaluation label/oracle only.
inference_inputs: Public geometry, known probe activities, measured powers above known floor with masks, planned delta. True G/H, future effect, context ID and split never enter inference.
model: Matched small response encoder, geometry encoder and positive 2x2 coupling decoder anchored to training-mean prior. The decoder applies H_hat*delta exactly. JEPA alone predicts an EMA-encoded future action/effect observation with variance regularisation; supervised family has identical inference graph/storage.

training.checkpoint_selection: None: fixed final epoch for every seed
training.future_teacher: Masked future measured effect only during JEPA loss; no teacher input at inference

numerical_references: online Bayesian/ridge system ID with the same training prior and scale
true effective G oracle label reference
rank_diagnostic: With equal total transmitter-on airtime, synchronized [1,1],[0,0] has rank1 and only identifies row sums; staggered [1,0],[0,1] has rank2. Show actual RT noiseless/unmasked recovery and contrast error. Repeating collinear observations cannot identify the unexcited direction. Separately report per-receiver observed rank with masks/noise.
metrics: native clean signed response MAE in mW
native noisy measured-effect MAE in mW
context-paired effects for K0/1/2 and both designs
teacher latent effective rank/variance and response-sensitivity collapse diagnostic
per-seed results and numerical baseline comparisons
success_gate: Only call this JEPA-specific benefit if final JEPA beats both matched supervised and strongest non-oracle numerical reference in context-paired test differences for staggered K1 and K2; each upper95% crossed context/training-seed bootstrap endpoint must be below zero. All test contexts from one warehouse; no universal/novelty/SOTA claim. Independent rank2 system-ID benefit is not JEPA superiority.
continual_scope: Sequential local belief/state assimilation of received probe data. No backbone weight updates at test time and no claim of solved continual learning/catastrophic forgetting.
activation: Offline simulation only; no active radio probe or hardware command
data_rights: Reuse configured warehouse fixture and actual traced path kernels with provenance/asset hashes; no additional dataset download or invented measurement fallback
